name: Terfenadine

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market in United States and 10 other countries, first in 1997 — for heart harm

summary: A small computer program, rather than tests in people, estimated that this drug has a low liver score and a high heart score [M]. The drug was pulled from the market in the United States and ten other countries starting in 1997 because of heart harm [3].
